sources.claim: The ticket requires new read-only MCP tools to retrieve team/bucket/test usage data.
The change map identifies the new UsageManager, endpoint constants, models, formatters, and server registration.
All three usage sources are available synchronously via api REST at tool-invocation time; no deleted-before-read hazard.
The api dependency contract: three endpoints returning {data:{id, requests_count, from_date, to_date}, meta, error}.
Scenarios cover count mapping, errors, default-window, read-only, and faithful pass-through.
Design alternatives compared; three separate usage tools selected with evidence.
Field semantics bind UsageManager/requests_count; requests_count is NEW, distinct from tests_count/result.requests.
The Constitution Check passes with no violations (all five principles).
Boundary compatibility: api Open Host Service / Published Language; consumer conforms with a thin formatter adapter.
Performance strategy: single synchronous api_request per tool invocation, no N×M fan-out.
